sections.title: Education Law & Policy Seminar
sections.description: The Home and School Visitor (HSV) Education Law & Policy Seminar meets the requirement for the HSV Certificate, addresses public education laws and policies, considers how poverty and racism influence public education, and provides a macro perspective to understand the role of the social worker in schools. The course is divided into five modules through January and February of the Spring semester. The course content will enhance your understanding of our system of public education and the role that social workers can play in helping it to uphold its mandate of providing a quality education for all students.
